text:
anya: Vendor dropped an updated rate table for 'BatchGen' (rate_id=BG-26-4). Need finance + billing ops review before any A/B or shadow. Sheet: https://vendor.example.com/sheets/BG-26-4
frank: Quick check  reserved SKUs unaffected or is this PAYG-only?
jordan: We must preserve any grandfathered discounts and one-off invoice adjustments. Don't want to remap coupons silently.
anya: PAYG only. Changes: new token breakpoints and a small rounding rule. It will change invoice line description to 'BatchGen (metered)'.
jordan: I sampled the mapping CSV and found three tricky cases: percent-off coupons, manual_invoice=true accounts, and accounts with billing_cycle_day!=1. Sample: ```acct_id,grandfathered,apply_new_rate
770001,true,false
770002,false,true```
anya: @billing-bot run preview cohort "bg-rate-sanity" (~9k) and return invoice delta histogram + coupon collision rate + top anomalies.
billing-bot: billing-bot: queued preview job job_id=jb_bg_42. ETA ~8m. Will post summary link.
reema: Vendor language also added a short termination sentence. Legal flagged it; expecting vendor to remove. Not blocking preview.
billing-bot: preview complete job_id=jb_bg_42. Summary: cohort_B median invoice +1.8%, coupon collisions 0.14%. Anomalies: 14 accounts with negative delta > $1k (proration+rounding mix). Report: https://internal/reports/jb_bg_42
frank: I'll run exposure calc. If negative delta exposure > $35k we convene finance.
jordan: Ops plan: translation-table patch to normalise rounding and respect manual_invoice flags, test in canary, then promote. I'll open PR to pricing repo and post to #eng-ops.
anya: Approval ask: patch in canary allowed. Abort rules: coupon collisions >0.5% OR >75 accounts >$1k delta. If canary green, target 1% PAYG canary tomorrow 09:00 PT.
legal-bot: legal-bot: flagged clause removed by vendor at 2026-04-12T14:05Z. No further legal objections.
reema: Sales wants a short FAQ clarifying grandfathering and invoice line changes. I'll draft and share once cohorts are final.
anya: Thanks all  keep updates here and post runbook in #release-war-room once validated.
